cadastru.infoTitle: What you can check in a cadastral result
cadastru.infoText:
Find a cadastral number by address and check official data for apartments, land and buildings in Moldova, without complicated geoportal searches.

Results include cadastral and geodata records: area, use, estimated cadastral value, floor, construction year and building details. You can also see the property on a map.

You can find land parcels with all their buildings. Search by address (apartment number is optional), or enter a cadastral number directly.

See nearby schools, supermarkets, pharmacies, restaurants, cafés and parks, with walking distances and times, plus public transport stops and routes.

In Chișinău, you can also check reports to City Hall from the last two years: issues at the address and nearby, with their resolution status.
